body: Merged #392 into this branch in 679a01dd to resolve the overlap in `recording-hub.ts` and `recorder-engine.ts`. Both fixes are kept: the bar lookup uses the source cache and still bails after a stop, and a failed compositor start releases both the screen tracks and the mic. Merge order is now #391, then #392, then this PR. Checks: `check-types` is clean, lint has 0 errors, the full suite passes (284 files, 2609 tests), and the recording and hub suites passed again after the final type fix.
